selection_review.codec_iterate: Configured generated codec_list places h264_cedar and hevc_cedar before native decoders; ID lookup returns wrappers.
selection_review.fallback: Native decoders are looked up by exact names h264 and hevc, avoiding wrapper recursion.
selection_review.build_binding: Final copied source SHA matches manifest; desktop_review checked source and object timestamps.

fixes_applied: Pending filtered AU backpressure retries internally with a 5-second progress bound, avoiding simultaneous send/receive EAGAIN.
Unexpected broker EOS outside drain becomes EPROTO; flush resets backpressure and timestamp state.
Timestamp rescale overflow is rejected rather than converted to unknown; normalized values respect broker nanosecond range.
Known unsupported pixel depth, chroma, interlace and codec profile use native fallback before opening hardware context.
Failed runtime native initialization frees unopened context, persists error, and avoids flushing a released hardware BSF.
Native fallback inherits caller max_pixels and apply_cropping limits.

executed_tests.runner: desktop_review; ARM64 candidate libraries executed by qemu-aarch64-static on build host
synthetic: Three consecutive backpressure events progress internally before send_packet returns.
Negative DTS offset and negative PTS after flush round trip.
Post-delivery EIO remains fatal; unexpected pre-drain EOS is EPROTO.
Known HEVC Main10 opens no stub hardware session.
fallback_modes: backend EIO after seven accepted packets and before first frame
backend EIO at drain after all packets accepted
executed_tests.comparisons: All eight 45-frame output sequences equal native in per-frame dimensions, format, pixel MD5, PTS, best_effort_timestamp and duration.

limitations: Tests use exported stub client APIs; no actual vendor decode, DMA, broker socket or browser sandbox behavior is tested.
No repeated browser-session allocation plateau or AXI DMA drain is established.
Unknown codec parameters rely on actual parser output validation before OMX; wrapper does not parse SPS itself.
Timestamp transport quantizes to microseconds; finer timebases and duplicate PTS metadata are not acceptance-tested.
Replay-cap exhaustion, forced allocation failure, and five-second stall timeout are source-reviewed but not exercised by this harness.
Current bypass DMA route still lacks IOMMU containment.
